title: Product law under a split-coordinate equivalence
statement: Let $m$ be a natural number, and let $p\in[0,1]$. The image of the product distribution of $2+(2m+1)$ independent samples from the biased sign distribution with parameter $p$, under the equivalence that splits the coordinates into blocks of sizes $2$ and $2m+1$, is the distribution obtained by first sampling the two blocks independently from their respective product distributions and then pairing them.
